_meta.name: Vantage Creative Knowledge Base
_meta.purpose: Seed data for the Vantage creative-director agent. The agent retrieves MECHANISMS (not campaigns) by matching business_type + goal + budget, remixes the mechanism into a fresh 2026-native idea grounded in the live cited research, then scores every idea against the rubric. Campaigns are stored as sourced example evidence.
_meta.how_to_use: Embed each mechanism's embedding_text into pgvector. Retrieve top-k by semantic match to the research brief + goal, filtered/boosted by business_type and budget_level. Pass retrieved mechanisms + live research into the creative_director node. Score outputs with rubric. Cite campaigns (with their source field) when using them as proof.
_meta.curated_by: senior creative director (human-curated + structured). This curation + structure is the proprietary moat vs. a raw model.
_meta.framing_guidance: Present every figure in its STRONGEST TRUE form: round toward the real number and use confident phrasing ('more than 80%', 'over 8 in 10', 'billions of impressions' when sourced), and lead with the biggest legitimately-supported number. NEVER state a figure larger than the source supports (e.g., do NOT call 81% 'around 90%' — 81 is around 80, and the attached source will contradict it). Only present high/medium-confidence figures as fact; present low-confidence figures as 'widely reported' or omit. Every figure keeps its source so it can be shown on request. This is how output stays impressive AND defensible.
_meta.accuracy_note: results_confidence flags: high = award body / brand financials / reputable trade press; medium = trade press or brand-reported single figures; low = contested, unverified, or no primary source. Some famous stats are inflated in popular retellings — flagged inline. Campaigns marked needs_sourcing:true were enumerated from research but not individually verified; source them before using their numbers as fact.
_meta.for_readers_and_employers: Every campaign has a `source` and a `results_confidence` flag (high/medium/low). AWARD WINS (Cannes Lions, Effie, D&AD, Clio) and ACQUISITIONS/FINANCIAL FILINGS are independently verifiable = high. Most engagement/ROI numbers (views, impressions, ROI multiples) come from the winning agency's own award submissions and are NOT independently audited = medium (treat as self-reported). Contested or conflated figures are listed in `do_not_state_as_fact` and must never be presented as fact. This sourcing discipline is deliberate: it's what makes the tool trustworthy and keeps a small business that repeats a stat out of FTC trouble.

rubric.description: Every generated idea must pass this. Reject below 7/10, or if it fails 'ownable', or matches a red_flag.

criteria.test: Swap in a competitor's name. If it still works, it's generic — FAIL.
Is there a non-obvious human/behavioral truth or reframe?
One memorable idea, sayable in one sentence?
Would a real person forward it unprompted (identity, humor, awe, utility)?
Dramatizes the business's real positioning gap and uses its distinctive assets?
Can the audience DO something (create, vote, hunt, duet, show-for-reward)?
Spreads with little/no paid media, vs. only working if you buy reach?
Backed by a genuine product/brand truth (hollow stunts backfire)?
Native to a 2025-26 channel (vertical video, reactive, UGC, AR)?

red_flags_auto_reject: 'make it go viral' as the strategy
imitates the category leader with no twist
borrowed meme with no brand truth
requires paid media just to be seen
undisclosed AI or fake reviews/testimonials (illegal under FTC rule)

trends_2026.short_form_video: The default format; marketers rank it most effective. Global short-form video ad spend projected at more than $110 billion in 2025 (Statista Digital Video Advertising Outlook). TikTok ~40% share; Reels & Shorts ~20% each. Most viewers decide in the first seconds — front-load the hook, design sound-on vertical.
trends_2026.ugc_and_creators: Real voices beat polish. The large majority of people (well over 80%) trust brands more when they share user-generated content (EnTribe, via Stack Influence). Micro-influencers outperform celebrity gloss for conversion.
trends_2026.reactive_meme: Speed + cultural fluency win (Oreo, Aviation Gin, Duolingo). A standing fast-response capability is table stakes.
trends_2026.community_build_in_public: Turn audiences into co-creators; founder-face and behind-the-scenes content build trust cheaply.
trends_2026.ai_disclosure_rules: AI content is mainstream but regulated. FTC fake-review rule (16 CFR Part 465) live since Oct 21, 2024 bans AI-generated fake reviews/testimonials. EU AI Act Art. 50 transparency/labeling applies from Aug 2, 2026. Platforms (Meta, TikTok, YouTube) auto-label realistic synthetic content. RULE: label realistic AI content; never fake endorsements/reviews.
trends_2026.experiential: Pop-ups/installations designed primarily to be captured as vertical video.

scrappy_small_business_playbook: Founder-face first — the owner on camera is the cheapest, highest-trust content; consistency beats production value.
Tell an underdog story — 'help save our shop' rallies communities (a struggling sushi shop hit millions of views on TikTok).
Mine your own real behaviors for a challenge (Chipotle #LidFlip came from an employee skill).
Tag local creators and pages to distribute — many are happy to amplify a local story.
React fast to local/cultural moments (the small-brand version of Oreo's blackout tweet).
Reply to every comment — the comment section is your content pipeline.
Make one 'banger' a month rather than daily noise.
Use free AI tools to raise output — but disclose realistic AI content per platform/FTC/EU rules.
Treat virality as a spike to convert into email/loyalty, not a permanent state.

mechanisms.why_it_works: Active participation + endowed-progress effect deepen engagement.
mechanisms.format_2026: Instagram/TikTok interactive filters, quizzes, and mini-games.
mechanisms.small_biz_example: A salon runs a 'find your color' interactive quiz that ends in a booking.
mechanisms.embedding_text: playable ad interactive branded game quiz choose your own adventure tinder swipe night participation

mechanisms.name: Live-data reactive OOH
mechanisms.definition: Out-of-home or social content that responds to real-world data or events in real time.
mechanisms.why_it_works: Novelty + relevance + wonder.
mechanisms.format_2026: Dynamic DOOH; localized 'live' social posts (the zero-budget local version is a chalkboard 'today's catch / weather special').
mechanisms.small_biz_example: A cafe posts a daily 'it's raining, here's a warm-drink deal' reactive story.
mechanisms.embedding_text: live data reactive out of home OOH real time british airways magic of flying lookup dynamic weather

mechanisms.name: One-for-one / purchase-triggered giving
mechanisms.definition: Every purchase triggers a donation or measurable real-world impact.
mechanisms.why_it_works: Warm-glow giving + identity signaling; buyers feel good and tell others.
mechanisms.format_2026: Live impact counters on-site and on receipts.
mechanisms.small_biz_example: A bakery donates a loaf for every loaf sold and shows the running total.
mechanisms.embedding_text: one for one purchase triggered giving donation impact bombas warm glow buy one give one

mechanisms.name: Creator-audience-first product
mechanisms.definition: Build an audience first, then launch a product into it at near-zero acquisition cost.
mechanisms.why_it_works: Parasocial trust + attention ownership means you don't have to buy customers.
mechanisms.format_2026: Creator drops and TikTok Shop.
mechanisms.small_biz_example: A local baker who built a big TikTok following launches a mix under her own name.
mechanisms.embedding_text: creator audience first product build audience then launch mrbeast feastables parasocial attention ownership

mechanisms.name: Gamify a mundane behavior (Fun Theory)
mechanisms.definition: Make a desirable-but-boring action fun so people choose to do it.
mechanisms.why_it_works: Intrinsic reward beats obligation or guilt at changing behavior.
mechanisms.format_2026: In-store gamified challenges and loyalty streaks.
mechanisms.small_biz_example: A gym turns check-ins into a visible streak game with small rewards.
mechanisms.embedding_text: fun theory gamify mundane behavior make boring fun piano stairs volkswagen intrinsic reward

mechanisms.name: Emotional storytelling (heartstring narrative)
mechanisms.definition: Tell a moving human story that makes people feel something, with the brand as a light touch.
mechanisms.why_it_works: Emotion drives memory and sharing far more than information does.
mechanisms.format_2026: Short emotional mini-docs; real-customer story Reels.
mechanisms.small_biz_example: A florist films the quiet story behind a regular's standing weekly order.
mechanisms.embedding_text: emotional storytelling heartstring narrative feeling moving human story budweiser puppy love john lewis emotion memory

campaigns.one_line: Frame everyday 'real women' as the beauty ideal.
campaigns.why: Rejected airbrushed norms the audience resented.
campaigns.results: Won Cannes Lions 2025 Grand Prix (Glass + Creative Strategy) for the 20-year platform; launched off research that only 2% of women called themselves beautiful.
campaigns.source: Cannes Lions 2025; Unilever 'Real Truth About Beauty' report

campaigns.one_line: Forensic artist draws women per their own vs. strangers' descriptions.
campaigns.why: Emotional proof beats claims.
campaigns.results: 163M global views; briefly the most-watched online ad ever; Titanium Grand Prix Cannes 2013.

campaigns.one_line: Absurdist one-take monologue addressed to women, then real-time video replies.
campaigns.why: Most body wash is bought by women; humor + live performance.
campaigns.results: Sales up more than 50% by mid-2010 (later doubled); Ad Age top campaign of the century.

campaigns.one_line: Universal athlete-grit slogan.
campaigns.why: Everyone is an 'athlete'; ownable human truth.
campaigns.results: Foundational brand equity; one of the most recognized slogans ever.

campaigns.one_line: Super Bowl film casting Mac as liberation from conformity.
campaigns.why: Positioned the leader (IBM) as Big Brother.
campaigns.results: Legendary; effectively aired once nationally.

campaigns.one_line: 'I'm a Mac / I'm a PC' personified comparison.
campaigns.why: Made specs human and funny.
campaigns.results: Credited with major Mac share gains over the run.

campaigns.one_line: User photos as the whole campaign.
campaigns.why: Product demo via real customers; democratized creativity.
campaigns.results: Cannes Lions 2025 Outdoor Grand Prix; one of Apple's longest-running platforms.

campaigns.one_line: Self-deprecating minimalist print for the Beetle ('Think Small', 'Lemon').
campaigns.why: Disarming candor in a chrome-obsessed era.
campaigns.results: Named among the greatest campaigns of the 20th century.

campaigns.one_line: Embrace being #2: 'We Try Harder.'
campaigns.why: Turned a weakness into a service promise.
campaigns.results: Grew share against Hertz; ran for decades.

campaigns.one_line: 'A Diamond Is Forever' links diamonds to eternal love.
campaigns.why: Manufactured the engagement-ring default (a ritual/norm).
campaigns.results: Reshaped an entire category for generations.

campaigns.one_line: 'Good things come to those who wait' epic.
campaigns.why: Reframed the slow pour as reward.
campaigns.results: Voted among the UK's best ads of all time.

campaigns.one_line: A gorilla drums to Phil Collins; product only at the end.
campaigns.why: Emotion/joy over product info, after a recall.
campaigns.results: Sales and favorability lift; Cannes-awarded.

campaigns.one_line: Friends yell 'Whassup?' on the phone.
campaigns.why: Ready-made social currency.
campaigns.results: Cannes Grand Prix; saturated pop culture.

campaigns.one_line: Hunger turns you into a diva/celebrity ('You're Not You When You're Hungry').
campaigns.why: Dramatizes a universal need-state; endlessly extendable.
campaigns.results: Global sales growth; Effie and Cannes wins.

campaigns.one_line: Cute characters die absurdly; be safe near trains.
campaigns.why: Humor bypasses PSA fatigue; an earworm song.
campaigns.results: Most-awarded Cannes campaign at the time (28 Lions, 5 Grand Prix). The widely-cited ~20% accident reduction is CONTESTED (Effie juries and Mumbrella questioned causality).
campaigns.source: Cannes; Mumbrella; Smith Brothers Media case study

campaigns.one_line: Annual emotional Christmas storytelling film.
campaigns.why: Anticipation becomes a national ritual.
campaigns.results: Strong seasonal sales correlation over many years.

campaigns.one_line: 'Compare the Meerkat' mascot pun.
campaigns.why: Distinctive mascot + wordplay cut through a boring category.
campaigns.results: Major share and consideration gains.

campaigns.one_line: Deadpan founder walk-and-talk mocking overpriced razors.
campaigns.why: Cheap, funny, precise pain point.
campaigns.results: Made for about $4,500 (director estimated a polished version would cost ~$50,000); 12,000 orders in 48 hours; more than 27M views; $1B Unilever acquisition (2016).
campaigns.source: NBC/Entrepreneur; Bret Waters case study; OptiMonk

campaigns.one_line: Canned water branded like heavy-metal beer.
campaigns.why: Sells identity/rebellion, not 'purity'; entertainment-first.
campaigns.results: More than $330M revenue in 2024; ~$1.4B valuation; the most-followed water brand on TikTok.

campaigns.one_line: Cheeky, verbose 'wtf'-style packaging and ads.
campaigns.why: Polarizing = memorable.
campaigns.results: Category growth and a cult following.

campaigns.one_line: Launch with 40 foundation shades, deep shades front-and-center.
campaigns.why: Served consumers the category ignored.
campaigns.results: Reported roughly $100M in sales in the first ~40 days.

campaigns.one_line: Ship 5 frames free to try at home.
campaigns.why: Friction removal drives trial + UGC.
campaigns.results: Fueled early DTC growth.

campaigns.one_line: A prince pooping rainbow ice cream explains the product.
campaigns.why: Humor makes an awkward product shareable.
campaigns.results: Reported large sales lift; more than 100M views across platforms.
campaigns.source: Harmon Brothers case study; trade press

campaigns.one_line: Billboards using ordinary people named 'Ronaldo', 'Serena', etc. as 'endorsers'.
campaigns.why: Cheap, clever, PR-friendly technically-true wordplay.
campaigns.results: Repeated viral earned media on a small budget.

campaigns.one_line: Fake conspiracy that Michael Cera invented CeraVe, revealed at the Super Bowl.
campaigns.why: Leaned into a pre-existing name coincidence; earned-first.
campaigns.results: Billions of earned impressions pre-reveal (brand cites 15.4B total; Ad Age/Ogilvy cite ~6-9B pre-game); purchase consideration rose from about 21% to about 28% (YouGov BrandIndex); brand-reported sales up ~25%; 2024 Cannes Social & Influencer Grand Prix + 2025 Clio Grand.
campaigns.results_confidence: medium (impressions high per brand; sales medium)
campaigns.source: Cannes 2024; Clio; YouGov BrandIndex; Ad Age

campaigns.one_line: Add 'and domestic violence' coverage to home insurance policies.
campaigns.why: Real utility redesigning the offer, not messaging.
campaigns.results: Three Cannes 2025 Grand Prix, including Titanium.

campaigns.one_line: Deepfake men onto women's football highlights, then reveal.
campaigns.why: Confronts bias viscerally.
campaigns.results: Two Cannes 2024 Grand Prix (Film + Sport), 10 Lions; Kantar top-1% of ads.

campaigns.one_line: Ask people worldwide to 'draw ketchup'; nearly all draw Heinz.
campaigns.why: Ownership proven by the crowd.
campaigns.results: 97% drew Heinz iconography; the platform reports billions of impressions and double-digit sales growth; Cannes 2023 Creative Effectiveness Grand Prix.
campaigns.source: Cannes Lions 2023; Kantar; Selfstorming case study

campaigns.one_line: Crushed/mangled-logo print urging recycling.
campaigns.why: Logo recognizable even when mangled.
campaigns.results: Cannes 2024 Print & Publishing Grand Prix.

campaigns.one_line: Generative AI turns shelter-dog photos into polished ad imagery.
campaigns.why: Media efficiency + purpose (helps real adoptions).
campaigns.results: Cannes 2024 Outdoor Grand Prix.

campaigns.one_line: 'NATURE' added as an official artist; streams fund conservation.
campaigns.why: Listening becomes climate action; an abstraction becomes a participant.
campaigns.results: Cannes 2025 Innovation Grand Prix.

campaigns.one_line: Play one second of iconic songs; dare fans to name them.
campaigns.why: Curiosity gap + replays; built on Gen Z skipping ads fast.
campaigns.results: Cannes 2025 Grand Prix (Brand Experience & Activation / Design / Digital Craft).

campaigns.one_line: First clinically-proven lotion for trans women in gender-affirming therapy.
campaigns.why: Real need, real product.
campaigns.results: Cannes 2024 Glass Grand Prix (Singapore's first).

campaigns.one_line: Scientists lab-test viral TikTok skincare hacks.
campaigns.why: Enters a live cultural conversation with credibility.
campaigns.results: Cannes Health & Wellness Grand Prix.

campaigns.one_line: Rick Astley re-records his hit with wrong lyrics to push hearing tests.
campaigns.why: The ad IS the demo of the problem.
campaigns.results: Cannes 2024 Audio & Radio Grand Prix.

campaigns.one_line: A real football-club job you apply for via Football Manager.
campaigns.why: Turns play into real stakes.
campaigns.results: Two Cannes 2024 Grand Prix (Gaming + Direct).

campaigns.one_line: Hide products/discounts inside video games ('Call of Discounts', 'Handshake Hunt').
campaigns.why: Play drives commerce.
campaigns.results: Cannes Gaming Grand Prix in both 2024 and 2025.

campaigns.one_line: Tweet during the Super Bowl blackout: 'You can still dunk in the dark.'
campaigns.why: Speed + relevance during a live moment.
campaigns.results: Massive earned media on essentially zero media spend.

campaigns.one_line: Unhinged owl mascot; 'Death of Duo' storyline.
campaigns.why: Comment section as brief; serialized lore drives participation.
campaigns.results: 'Death of Duo' drove more than a billion impressions and about double the top Super Bowl brand's social buzz; a Dua Lipa reshare drove hundreds of thousands of actions; boosts DAU and downloads.

campaigns.one_line: Savage, fast replies roasting users and competitors.
campaigns.why: Screenshot-worthy conflict as entertainment.
campaigns.results: Large follower and engagement growth; widely imitated.

campaigns.one_line: Fast-follow parody casting the viral 'Peloton wife' in a gin ad.
campaigns.why: Days-fast newsjack of a trending controversy.
campaigns.results: Huge earned media within days.

campaigns.one_line: Self-aware 'we're cheap and rude' mascot content.
campaigns.why: Owning the criticism defuses it.
campaigns.results: Millions of followers; high engagement.

campaigns.one_line: Earnest media-literacy threads from a frozen-meat brand.
campaigns.why: Novelty + sincerity from an unexpected source.
campaigns.results: Viral goodwill and press.

campaigns.one_line: 'Believe in something' narrated by Colin Kaepernick.
campaigns.why: Aligned with core-audience identity, accepting backlash.
campaigns.results: Online sales rose about 31% in the 72 hours after launch (Edison Trends); stock dipped ~3% then recovered to a record; record FY19 revenue of $39.1B.

campaigns.one_line: Reclaim 'like a girl' as empowering via a filmed experiment.
campaigns.why: Shifts perception live and emotionally.
campaigns.results: Billions of impressions; positive association among 16-24-year-old women rose from about 19% to about 76% (P&G/Millward Brown); Emmy + inaugural Cannes Glass Lion + Grand Effie.
campaigns.source: Cannes; Institute for Public Relations; P&G/Millward Brown

campaigns.one_line: Dump ice water, nominate three, donate.
campaigns.why: Social proof + a 24-hour deadline + ego.
campaigns.results: Raised $115M for the ALS Association versus $2.8M in the same period the prior year (about a 40x jump); more than 17M participants; funded the NEK1 gene discovery and AMX0035 (later FDA-approved).

campaigns.one_line: Black Friday NYT ad: 'Don't Buy This Jacket.'
campaigns.why: Anti-consumption authentically proved values and deepened loyalty.
campaigns.results: The widely-cited ~30% sales increase over the following nine months is CONTESTED — repeated by outlets like IMD but with no Patagonia primary source, and the causal claim is oversimplified.

campaigns.one_line: A defiant girl statue faces the Wall Street bull; promotes the SHE ETF.
campaigns.why: One object, global meaning.
campaigns.results: Four Cannes Grand Prix and 18 Lions; billions of social impressions. NOTE: State Street settled a roughly $5M gender/race pay case months later — a well-documented irony.
campaigns.results_confidence: medium (awards high; the pay-settlement irony is well-documented)

campaigns.one_line: A rearranged-logo print apology ('FCK') for a chicken shortage.
campaigns.why: Owns the mistake and disarms anger (humility, humour, honesty).
campaigns.results: Reached an audience in the hundreds of millions to about a billion; YouGov positive attention rose from about 7% to about 29%; Cannes Lions.

campaigns.one_line: Anti-palm-oil animation banned from TV.
campaigns.why: Censorship amplifies reach.
campaigns.results: Tens of millions of views and huge earned media after the 'ban'.

campaigns.one_line: Publicly admitted the pizza was bad and showed the reformulation.
campaigns.why: Radical self-criticism made the improvement believable.
campaigns.results: Same-store sales jumped 14.3% the following quarter; a multi-year stock surge followed.

campaigns.one_line: Replace the logo with common first names.
campaigns.why: Finding a name is a social gesture, not a purchase.
campaigns.results: In Australia, young-adult consumption rose about 7% and share rose about 4%; in the US it helped reverse a multi-year decline (about +2%); more than 150M personalized bottles; 7 Cannes wins.

campaigns.one_line: Personalized annual listening recap in shareable story cards.
campaigns.why: Ego + FOMO + social proof; identity currency.
campaigns.results: In 2025, more than 200M users engaged within 24 hours (up about 19% year over year) and hundreds of millions of shares; the 2020 launch drove roughly a 21% app-download spike.

campaigns.one_line: Names/personal labels on jars.
campaigns.why: Personalization-as-collectible drives gifting.
campaigns.results: Sell-outs in multiple markets.

campaigns.one_line: Endless creative riffs on the bottle silhouette.
campaigns.why: Consistency + variety on one ownable asset.
campaigns.results: One of the longest-running print campaigns ever.

campaigns.one_line: Turn the world pink; 150+ partnerships; an AI selfie generator.
campaigns.why: Everyone becomes a channel; pink as a participatory uniform.
campaigns.results: About $150M marketing spend; more than $1.4B box office; the selfie tool was used more than 13M times.

campaigns.one_line: A 1-cent Whopper unlockable only at a McDonald's location.
campaigns.why: Playful trolling + reward turns a rival's footprint into your asset.
campaigns.results: About 1.5M app downloads in 9 days; billions of impressions; Cannes Titanium/Direct/Mobile Grand Prix. ROI is SOURCE-DEPENDENT: Adweek cites 37:1 and 3.5B impressions 'according to the chain'; Burger King's own case study states 27:1 and 3.3B — use the range, not the top number.
campaigns.source: Adweek; The One Club (BK case study)

campaigns.one_line: Show a Whopper rotting to prove no artificial preservatives.
campaigns.why: Disgust proves the claim; un-fakeable.
campaigns.results: Cannes-awarded; large polarizing buzz.

campaigns.one_line: A grandson's TikTok asks people to save grandpa's struggling restaurant.
campaigns.why: Community rallies for a face.
campaigns.results: Millions of views; crowds followed.

campaigns.one_line: A TikTok consultant engineers a 'save the restaurant' video.
campaigns.why: Underdog appeal + creator/local-page tagging distributes it.
campaigns.results: Roughly 580,000 views versus a hoped-for 10,000; local news pickup. (Sales slowed after the spike — treat virality as a spike to convert.)

campaigns.one_line: A TikTok dance challenge for free guac on National Avocado Day.
campaigns.why: Low-barrier participation tied to a real reward and a calendar moment.
campaigns.results: Hundreds of millions of video views; a record guacamole day.

campaigns.one_line: Livestreamed a supersonic freefall from about 128,000 feet.
campaigns.why: Embodied 'gives you wings' through a real human feat.
campaigns.results: About 8 million concurrent YouTube live viewers (then a record); carried by hundreds of partners in dozens of countries.
campaigns.results_confidence: high (some secondary sales figures are unverified)

campaigns.one_line: Co-create the Paris Olympics rather than merely sponsor.
campaigns.why: Cultural contribution beats a logo placement.
campaigns.results: Cannes 2025 Luxury Grand Prix; hundreds of millions of euros in earned media.

campaigns.one_line: Anti-marketing prank stunts (e.g., 'Holiday Hole').
campaigns.why: Rewards in-group irony; signals brand confidence.
campaigns.results: Recurring earned media.

campaigns.one_line: Eco toilet paper donating 50% of profits to sanitation.
campaigns.why: Purpose + humor built into the product.
campaigns.results: Millions donated; strong DTC growth.

campaigns.one_line: Absurd collabs (e.g., with Depend) and stunts.
campaigns.why: Cross-audience novelty + earned press.
campaigns.results: Repeated viral earned media.

campaigns.one_line: Turn hostile social comments into a heavy-metal album ('Greatest Hates').
campaigns.why: Disarms critics and signals confidence.
campaigns.results: Viral earned media; ongoing series.

campaigns.one_line: A NYC vending machine dispensing 'dirty water' labeled with diseases, for $1 donations.
campaigns.why: Makes a distant crisis visceral and local via an everyday object.
campaigns.results: High-share, low-cost guerrilla; widely covered.

campaigns.one_line: A poised woman frankly explains bathroom odor.
campaigns.why: Humor makes a taboo product talkable.
campaigns.results: Tens of millions of views; strong sales.

campaigns.one_line: Hid free-phone deals in ads triggered only by Googling quirky keywords.
campaigns.why: Turns ad-avoidance into a game.
campaigns.results: Reported large engagement lift; Cannes 2023.

campaigns.one_line: A TV ad that triggered viewers' Google Home devices to read the Whopper's Wikipedia entry.
campaigns.why: Hijacks an adjacent device/medium for reach.
campaigns.results: Cannes Direct Grand Prix; huge earned media (and controversy).

campaigns.one_line: A limited ceramics-inspired collection with a Japanese studio.
campaigns.why: Scarcity + craft story drives desire.
campaigns.results: Sold-out drops and press.

campaigns.one_line: Creator-founder shows the product-design process.
campaigns.why: Story + consistency build investment.
campaigns.results: Viral product drops.

campaigns.one_line: A satirical song urging you NOT to play it safe.
campaigns.why: Craft + wit embodying brand spirit.
campaigns.results: Cannes 2024 Film Grand Prix.

campaigns.one_line: See coca_cola_recycle_me (distinctive-asset flex for a recycling message).
campaigns.why: Duplicate reference; see coca_cola_recycle_me.
campaigns.results: Cannes 2024 Print & Publishing Grand Prix.

campaigns.one_line: Jean-Claude Van Damme does a split between two reversing trucks to prove dynamic steering.
campaigns.why: Awe + a single-take, unfakeable feat makes a B2B feature massively shareable.
campaigns.results: More than 72M YouTube views (Contagious calls it the most-watched automotive ad on YouTube); ~EUR126M / $172.6M in EARNED MEDIA value.
campaigns.results_confidence: high (views/earned media); the circulating '$170M revenue' figure is a misread of earned-media value and is NOT revenue

campaigns.one_line: A-list-directed action short films starring Clive Owen as 'The Driver'.
campaigns.why: Put premium content where affluent male buyers already were, before 'content marketing' existed.
campaigns.results: IPA case: films cost ~56% of traditional advertising for the exposure gained, more than doubled BMW's growth (a 74% sales increase), ~$26M free publicity, 11M+ views in 4 months.

campaigns.one_line: An absurdly worldly gentleman endorses 'the beer he doesn't always drink'.
campaigns.why: Humor + aspiration; a spokesman embodying the drinker's fantasy self.
campaigns.results: Heineken USA states US volume tripled over the 10-year campaign; widely cited ~22% US sales rise in 2009. Context: Dos Equis retail sales fell ~8% in 2025 (NIQ), prompting a revival.

campaigns.one_line: 85+ Accord parts trigger a Rube Goldberg chain reaction in one take.
campaigns.why: Craft as proof of engineering precision.
campaigns.results: Honda/Campaign cite UK sales nearly doubling by 2005; Gold Lion 2003.

campaigns.one_line: 250,000 colored balls bounce down San Francisco hills ('like no other').
campaigns.why: Pure aesthetic emotion in a commodity LCD market.
campaigns.results: Credited with Sony's LCD share turnaround; millions of views.

campaigns.one_line: Show the misery of running out of milk ('Got Milk?').
campaigns.why: Loss aversion; milk framed as the complement you miss when it's gone.
campaigns.results: California sales ~+7% in year one, reversing a decade of decline; 90%+ awareness.
campaigns.results_confidence: high (short-term CA); CONTESTED (it did not reverse the long-term national per-capita decline)

campaigns.one_line: An elderly woman demands 'Where's the beef?' from a tiny rival patty.
campaigns.why: Comparative humor + a catchphrase that escaped into culture.
campaigns.results: Widely cited sales +31% in 1984, reaching ~$945M by 1985.

campaigns.one_line: Multicultural youth sing a unity jingle ('I'd Like to Buy the World a Coke').
campaigns.why: Post-1960s idealism; the jingle became a charting single.
campaigns.results: 100,000+ letters to Coca-Cola; the jingle charted. No reliable direct sales figure.

campaigns.one_line: A puppy-and-Clydesdale friendship Super Bowl spot.
campaigns.why: Warmth + pre-release social seeding; the Clydesdales are a distinctive asset.
campaigns.results: ~1.34M shares (Unruly) - the most-shared 2014 Super Bowl ad; USA Today Ad Meter winner; 50M+ views. No sales figure.

campaigns.one_line: A life-size Fabia built entirely from cake ('Full of lovely stuff').
campaigns.why: Craft + charm overturn a 'naff' brand perception.
campaigns.results: 260k+ YouTube views in 2 weeks (700k+ by June); YouGov perception lift.

campaigns.one_line: An animated film + mobile game indicting industrial food ('The Scarecrow').
campaigns.why: Emotional story + a gamified reward drives people to the store.
campaigns.results: 5.6M views in a week; #1 iTunes adventure game; 18.4M social conversations in month one (agency); Cannes PR Grand Prix 2014.

campaigns.one_line: Reserve marathon bib 321 (Trisomy-21) for a neurodivergent athlete.
campaigns.why: An iconic number gives an overlooked community visibility.
campaigns.results: All six world marathon majors reserved a bib; 278 athletes signed up; ~268M earned impressions; Cannes Direct Grand Prix 2023.

campaigns.one_line: 'Is laundry only a woman's job?' challenges household gender norms.
campaigns.why: A gender-equity movement tied directly to product superiority.
campaigns.results: Effie APAC: +60% sales, 1.6B earned impressions, 1.5M+ male pledges; #1 in the 2017 WARC 100.

campaigns.one_line: Geo-targeted ads that double as free ads for local shops; an AI-cloned Shah Rukh Khan for 85,000+ retailers.
campaigns.why: Personalization + purpose helping small businesses survive the pandemic.
campaigns.results: Cannes Titanium Lion 2022 + Creative Effectiveness Grand Prix 2023.

campaigns.one_line: Hide a virtual Easter egg for a loved one anywhere on Google Street View.
campaigns.why: Generosity + play turned into e-commerce.
campaigns.results: ~800k eggs hidden in Year 1; 515M reach (agency).

campaigns.one_line: Pay fishers to haul ocean plastic instead of fish.
campaigns.why: Purpose executed through existing infrastructure.
campaigns.results: ~20 tons of plastic recovered, 2.2B impressions (PR-reported); 3 Gold Lions 2022.

campaigns.one_line: A sitcom-style team saves a pitch using Apple products.
campaigns.why: Relatable workplace comedy carries B2B product integration.
campaigns.results: D&AD Pencil 2020; no sales metrics disclosed.

campaigns.one_line: A foul ball 'broke' a Coors LED ad, so they made a dead-pixel special-edition can in 48 hours.
campaigns.why: Agile reactive marketing off an unofficial sports moment.
campaigns.results: Two Gold Cannes Lions 2024 (Outdoor; Brand Experience).

campaigns.one_line: John McEnroe plays AI-generated avatars of his younger selves.
campaigns.why: Spectacle carries the 'it's only worth it if you enjoy it' idea.
campaigns.results: 2023 Sports Emmy; 10M+ views, +95% brand searches (agency/press release).

campaigns.one_line: A diverse, unfiltered depiction of womb experiences (periods, endometriosis, menopause, IVF).
campaigns.why: Emotional honesty breaks a long-standing category taboo.
campaigns.results: UK share +14% (agency); 100M+ views; Cannes Titanium + Film Craft + Health & Wellness Grand Prix 2021.

campaigns.one_line: A censorship-proof library of banned journalism built inside Minecraft.
campaigns.why: Reaches youth where censors can't follow.
campaigns.results: Reached gamers in 165 countries; 790+ articles; +62% RSF donations (agency); Cannes PR Grand Prix 2020.

campaigns.one_line: An in-app first-person apocalypse choose-your-own-adventure that shapes your matches.
campaigns.why: Turns passive swiping into a shared narrative for Gen Z.
campaigns.results: ~20M participants; +26% matches on Swipe Nights.

campaigns.one_line: MC Hammer + 'Cheetle' dust as an excuse to dodge tasks.
campaigns.why: Humor + nostalgia turn the messy orange dust into the whole idea.
campaigns.results: 119M+ TikTok effect impressions and brand-lift gains (self-reported).

campaigns.one_line: First brand-commissioned original TikTok song + hashtag challenge.
campaigns.why: Native UGC co-creation for Gen Z at low cost.
campaigns.results: Billions of hashtag views and 3.5M+ UGC videos (counts vary by source); the song hit #4 on the Spotify viral chart.

campaigns.one_line: A bouncing, color-shifting QR code on a black screen for 60 Super Bowl seconds.
campaigns.why: A pure curiosity gap drives direct response.
campaigns.results: 20M+ landing hits in a minute (crashed the site); app rose #186 to #2 in the App Store; won a Super Clio.

campaigns.one_line: Cards displaying a chosen name for trans/non-binary users without a legal name change.
campaigns.why: Inclusion built into the product, not just the messaging.
campaigns.results: Cannes Brand Experience Grand Prix 2021; Clio/D&AD Black Pencil.

campaigns.one_line: 258 real young Londoners one-up each other's sport struggles, with star cameos.
campaigns.why: Hyperlocal specificity plus celebrity cameos.
campaigns.results: London Nike searches +93% (Lyst); Cannes Social & Influencer Grand Prix + Titanium 2018.

campaigns.one_line: Challenging 'toxic masculinity' and reworking the tagline.
campaigns.why: A purpose stand in the #MeToo era - the cautionary case for this mechanism.
campaigns.results: CONTESTED: among YouTube's most-disliked videos; the $8B P&G Gillette writedown is NOT clearly attributable to the ad; business impact is genuinely disputed.

campaigns.one_line: Black parents prepare their children for racial bias ('The Talk').
campaigns.why: A cultural truth told unflinchingly.
campaigns.results: Cannes Film Grand Prix 2018 + Primetime Emmy; 1.86B impressions (agency).

campaigns.one_line: Urged users to turn their backs on TikTok's 'Bold Glamour' AI beauty filter.
campaigns.why: A body-esteem stand, briefed-to-live in days.
campaigns.results: 1B+ impressions (agency); Cannes Media Grand Prix 2023.

campaigns.one_line: Comic scenarios of eyesight failures ('Should've gone to Specsavers').
campaigns.why: Consistent humor builds an ownable, repeatable line.
campaigns.results: ~92% UK awareness (Tracksuit); Marketing Week Brand of the Year 2025.

campaigns.one_line: An eyebrow-raise (mimicking the arches) as a silent invitation; no product shown.
campaigns.why: An ownable, wordless non-verbal cue.
campaigns.results: Silver Cannes Lion 2023; the broader brand-love strategy is tied to ~GBP1.2bn incremental revenue in the IPA case (multi-year, not this ad alone).

campaigns.one_line: Promised to deliver every product advertised in the Super Bowl via one promo code.
campaigns.why: Meta-newsjacking the entire broadcast, not one slot.
campaigns.results: Dan Wieden Titanium Grand Prix 2024.

campaigns.one_line: A Pop-Tart mascot is crowned, then 'baked and eaten' by the bowl-game winner.
campaigns.why: Absurd spectacle spawns endless social chatter.
campaigns.results: Cannes Brand Experience & Activation Grand Prix 2024.

campaigns.one_line: A B2B media-plan Excel spreadsheet turned into a music video.
campaigns.why: Makes a dry B2B artifact delightful.
campaigns.results: Cannes Digital Craft Grand Prix 2024.

campaigns.one_line: A man's morning routine unfolds in a single transforming square metre.
campaigns.why: Craft demonstrates 'every square metre deserves the best'.
campaigns.results: Cannes Film Craft Grand Prix 2024.

campaigns.one_line: OOH images swap phones for KitKats in everyday scrolling moments.
campaigns.why: A wordless image reinforces 'Have a break'.
campaigns.results: Cannes Outdoor Grand Prix 2025.

campaigns.one_line: An outdoor campaign built entirely on Magnum's visual codes.
campaigns.why: Distinctive assets carry the message with no copy.
campaigns.results: Cannes Outdoor Grand Prix 2024.

campaigns.one_line: Children's audiobooks that fold scary MRI sounds into the story.
campaigns.why: Reframes a frightening medical experience for kids.
campaigns.results: Cannes Health & Wellness Grand Prix 2024.

campaigns.one_line: A 100-year-old grandmother 'takes over' Madrid's subway to prove poster power.
campaigns.why: A charming demonstration of OOH reach.
campaigns.results: Cannes Creative B2B Grand Prix 2024.

campaigns.one_line: Sell returned products (with an upgraded warranty) cheaper to cut waste.
campaigns.why: Sustainability turned into a business model.
campaigns.results: Cannes Creative Business Transformation Grand Prix 2024.

campaigns.one_line: Lend cars to people in transit-poor areas so they can reach jobs ('CareMakers').
campaigns.why: Solves a real barrier to employment.
campaigns.results: Cannes Creative Commerce + SDG Grand Prix 2024.

campaigns.one_line: A data platform matching Ukrainian refugees with Polish towns where they'll thrive.
campaigns.why: Data solves a humanitarian and economic problem at once.
campaigns.results: Cannes Creative Data Grand Prix 2024.

campaigns.one_line: A destigmatization course + a live ranking framing NZ as 'the best place to have herpes'.
campaigns.why: Humor disarms a heavy stigma.
campaigns.results: Cannes Health Grand Prix for Good 2025.

campaigns.one_line: Bootstrapped gymwear built on long-term micro-influencer partnerships and the #Gymshark66 challenge.
campaigns.why: Authentic creators + a community identity, not paid media.
campaigns.results: FY2023 revenue GBP556.2M (~96% DTC); ~$1.45B valuation in 2020 (General Atlantic).
campaigns.source: Company filings via Appbrew; General Atlantic

campaigns.one_line: Won Intuit's free Super Bowl 50 ad as 'the world's strongest coffee'.
campaigns.why: A David-vs-Goliath story powered by community voting.
campaigns.results: Revenue ~$3M in 2015 grew to ~$20M after the ad (Intuit, confirmed by the founder to Ad Age); 150,000+ site visitors within seconds; expanded from 7 to 150 stores.
campaigns.source: Intuit QuickBooks; Ad Age; Fortune; CNN

campaigns.one_line: 'A new kind of soda' - prebiotic, low-sugar, nostalgia-forward.
campaigns.why: Reframes soda as functional; heavy creator content.
campaigns.results: $400M sales in 2024; ~$1.85B valuation Feb 2025; 2,128% three-year growth (Inc 5000).

campaigns.one_line: Prebiotic soda; founder-led TikTok + influencer blitz; two Super Bowl ads.
campaigns.why: Native TikTok content before its CPG peers.
campaigns.results: $500M+ in 2024 sales; acquired by PepsiCo for $1.95B in 2025.
campaigns.results_confidence: high (acquisition); CONTESTED (its 2025 Super Bowl vending-machine influencer stunt drew 'out of touch' backlash)

campaigns.one_line: Natural men's soap; edutainment videos ('You're not a dish, you're a man'); first Super Bowl ad.
campaigns.why: Entertaining education flips a boring category.
campaigns.results: ~$100M revenue in 2020 with 350% YoY growth for two years; the Super Bowl ad drove ~200% best-seller-rank lift and ~100% day-of sales growth (company-stated).

campaigns.one_line: Deliberately unequal chocolate segments symbolize cocoa-industry inequality.
campaigns.why: The product itself IS the message; historically near-zero paid media.
campaigns.results: EUR240M revenue in 2025 (+20%), with US sales +50% YoY; allocated 0% to paid TV/radio for most of its history.

campaigns.one_line: Creator-owned chocolate launched to 300M+ subscribers, Walmart-first.
campaigns.why: Attention ownership means near-zero marginal customer-acquisition cost.
campaigns.results: Per Bloomberg (citing documents sent to investors), Feastables generated ~$250M in sales and >$20M profit in 2024, up from $33M (2022) and $96M (2023).

campaigns.one_line: Buy-one-give-one socks and apparel.
campaigns.why: Purpose drives word-of-mouth; quality retains.
campaigns.results: $1.3B+ lifetime sales (the first Shark Tank company to reach $1B) and 150M+ items donated.

campaigns.one_line: Subway stairs turned into a working piano to promote BlueMotion eco tech ('The Fun Theory').
campaigns.why: Fun beats guilt at changing behavior.
campaigns.results: 66% more people chose the stairs over the escalator (single-site observation); 20M+ YouTube views.

campaigns.one_line: A big red button on a quiet square unleashes staged mayhem to launch a 'drama' channel.
campaigns.why: Irresistible curiosity + a shareable spectacle.
campaigns.results: ~30M views; the 2nd-most-shared ad on YouTube at the time.

campaigns.one_line: Digital billboards show a child pointing at real BA planes overhead, with live flight data ('#lookup').
campaigns.why: Real-time data + wonder.
campaigns.results: 1.36M views, 45M earned impressions, 364 articles in 118 countries (Ogilvy); Cannes Direct Grand Prix.

campaigns.one_line: A billboard bruise heals as more passersby (via facial recognition) look at it.
campaigns.why: Participation implicates bystanders in domestic-abuse apathy.
campaigns.results: Dwell time +349%; reach 326.9M across 20 countries (Quividi/SOFII); Cannes Gold Outdoor 2015.

campaigns.one_line: Video-portal vending machines let strangers in India and Pakistan complete tasks together.
campaigns.why: Shared humanity across a hostile border.
campaigns.results: Site traffic doubled and sharing rose +500% (Cannes case); Gold Lion 2013.

campaigns.one_line: An AR app 'burns' a McDonald's ad to reveal a free Whopper.
campaigns.why: Hijacks a competitor's media spend.
campaigns.results: 9 Cannes Lions 2019; in-app sales +55% and ~1M free Whoppers (agency; figures vary).

campaigns.one_line: Temporarily 'renamed' itself IHOb to launch a burger line.
campaigns.why: Outrage and curiosity earn massive free media.
campaigns.results: Burger sales quadrupled post-campaign (stated on Dine Brands' Q2 2018 earnings call); 20,000+ media stories, ~36B impressions.
campaigns.results_confidence: high (earnings call); CONTESTED (some Foursquare foot-traffic data showed flat traffic)

campaigns.one_line: After M&S sued over its Cuthbert caterpillar cake, Aldi ran a witty '#FreeCuthbert' campaign.
campaigns.why: Agile humor won public sympathy in a legal fight.
campaigns.results: 500M+ social impressions; Twitter following +30%; GBP0 media spend; news sentiment Aldi +8.5% vs M&S -134% (agency case).

campaigns.one_line: A single tweet of Weetabix topped with Heinz beans; dozens of brands piled in.
campaigns.why: 'Would you / wouldn't you' divisiveness fuels sharing.
campaigns.results: 1B+ views; +15% sales at Sainsbury's that week; spontaneous awareness +40%; GBP0 paid.
campaigns.source: Marketing Week; The Grocer; Campaign Live; Netimperative

campaigns.one_line: Relaunched a failing sauce by hijacking a viral Taylor Swift NFL photo ('Ketchup & Seemingly Ranch').
campaigns.why: Rides a Swiftie moment in real time.
campaigns.results: Agency-reported 6.1B impressions, $160M earned media, and a 52,987% ROI.
campaigns.results_confidence: medium (self-reported; the ROI figure especially should not be stated as fact)

campaigns.one_line: Absurdist, self-aware sponge-mascot skits native to TikTok.
campaigns.why: Entertainment-first content for Gen Z.
campaigns.results: $220M+ revenue in 2023 (Reuters); 4M+ TikTok followers.

campaigns.one_line: A cheery back-to-school ad turns into a school shooting; supplies become survival tools.
campaigns.why: Subverts a familiar format for a gut-punch.
campaigns.results: 26M views in 24 hours; $100k in donations on day one; +400% site visits on a $37k paid budget; 3.9B impressions; 2020 Primetime Emmy.

campaigns.one_line: Strangers with opposing views build a bar, then choose to talk over a beer.
campaigns.why: Bridges division with the product as facilitator (a smarter counterpoint to the Pepsi/Kendall Jenner ad).
campaigns.results: 40M+ views; UK off-trade volume +11.9% vs the prior year - nearly twice premium-lager category growth (Nielsen, in the IPA case).

campaigns.one_line: Revisits the first speeches of Putin, Erdogan, and Maduro to defend press freedom.
campaigns.why: The leaders' own early pro-freedom words indict them.
campaigns.results: Cannes Grand Prix for Good 2024.

campaigns.one_line: Documents the Afghan Youth Women's football team's escape, aided by encrypted chat.
campaigns.why: Shows encryption as a real-world lifeline.
campaigns.results: Cannes Entertainment Grand Prix 2024.

campaigns.one_line: A portrait of Holocaust survivor Margot Friedlander for a 'read by brilliant minds' print series.
campaigns.why: Craft + gravitas on Holocaust Remembrance Day.
campaigns.results: Cannes Industry Craft Grand Prix 2024.

do_not_state_as_fact.issue: '$170M revenue' conflates ~EUR126M/$172.6M earned-media VALUE with revenue. Use the earned-media framing.
Business impact is genuinely disputed; the $8B P&G Gillette writedown is not clearly attributable to the ad.
Did NOT reverse the long-term national per-capita milk decline; only the short-term California figure is solid.
Environmental efficacy is questioned; tonnage/impression figures are PR-reported.
The 52,987% ROI (and $160M earned media) is a self-reported agency calculation - do not state as fact.
The famous '+30% sales' has no primary source; the causal claim is oversimplified.
The ~20% accident-reduction claim is contested; causality was questioned by Effie juries.
ROI is source-dependent: 37:1 (press, 'per the chain') vs 27:1 (brand's own case). Use the range.
Burger-sales-quadrupled is from the earnings call (solid), but some Foursquare foot-traffic data showed flat traffic.
Revenue is Reuters-sourced, but the causal link to TikTok is not established.
Acquisition price is solid; its 2025 Super Bowl vending-machine stunt drew 'out of touch' backlash.
Impression/lift stats are unverified; rely on the awards.

Any views/impressions/ROI drawn from a winning agency's award submission is self-reported and not independently audited - present as 'reported' not 'proven'. Award WINS and acquisitions/financial filings are verifiable.
